architecture: Static shared-shape MLP on log10 physical gates/10,18->32SiLU->11 plus linear skip. Full18 physical gates supplied; no latent compression or recurrence. All arms per seed start with the same weight matrices; only registered output bias/parameterization differs. Targets analytic openings, no P distillation.
representation_contract: sigmoid_zero starts logits0; sigmoid_fit_bias initializes perchannel bias from fit mean log10 opening transformed to logits; log_exp predicts log10opening=min(raw,0), starts at fit mean log10opening and exponentiates only at output. No lower output clamp. log loss uses soft floor1e-30 only inside logarithm; exact zeros separately tested by analytic oracle and never called exactly representable by neural output.
loss_contract: absolute:mean opening squared error. log_balanced: mean squared log10(pred+1e-30)-log10(target+1e-30), divided900, with equal fit-channel log-decade-bin sampling. Absolute arms use uniform rows from same sampled candidate pool. This is a declared joint objective/sampling intervention, not isolated denominator effect.
selection: Checkpoint per arm/seed selected on same development log-error score, tied earliest; report absolute score also. Freeze before fresh access. No overall winner promoted and no fresh-based tuning.
evaluation: Reachable samples before/during/after rest, and separate off-manifold positive synthetic gates spanning1e-12..1. Same V/Ca and gbar/reversals for canonical and predicted current. Original current_nrmse0.01/current_nmax0.05 per trajectory and channel; per-decade opening/log errors are diagnostics, not new gates. Zero/boundary algebraic controls; physical log roundtrip FP64/FP32; P frozen parameter check only because this is static, not P dynamics comparison.

hypotheses.claim: Uncalibrated sigmoid initialization makes tiny openings hard to learn.
hypotheses.contrast: sigmoid_fit_bias versus sigmoid_zero at fixed loss; same matrices.

hypotheses.claim: Log-coordinate output improves tiny-opening learnability beyond bias alone.
hypotheses.contrast: log_exp versus sigmoid_fit_bias at fixed loss and same log-input MLP; no recurrence.

hypotheses.claim: Absolute loss and sample frequency neglect low-opening regimes.
hypotheses.contrast: absolute/uniform versus log_balanced at fixed representation; perdecade and reachable/offmanifold readback.

hypotheses.claim: A numerical floor or target construction error explains the observed failure.
hypotheses.contrast: Exact analytic product, log-domain roundtrip and zero/boundary controls versus networks.

cost.scope: Static packed18model readout vs analytic product; different workload, not permodel or whole-neuron speedup.

limitations: No recurrence, compressed-state or slow-memory conclusion. Full physical state available. Synthetic log-gates not claimed biologically reachable. P and original thresholds unchanged. Neural outputs need not represent exact zero; blocked-current behavior is analytic gbar=0, not learned.
